Package common.utility.sysid

Class NAR_SysIdCommand

java.lang.Object
common.utility.sysid.NAR_SysIdCommand
public class NAR_SysIdCommand extends Object
Runs WPILib's SysId tests on a mechanism and records the results, so the SysId tool can work out its feedforward gains (kS, kV, kA, kG) for you.

SysId runs two kinds of test, each forward and backward:

  • Quasistatic: the voltage rises slowly, so the mechanism barely accelerates. This measures kS and kV.
  • Dynamic: the voltage jumps straight to a step, so the mechanism accelerates hard. This measures kA.
Each test stops after a timeout, 10 seconds unless you give one. For a mechanism with limited travel, like an arm or elevator, pick a timeout short enough that it can't reach the end of its travel, or cancel the test before it does.

The results go into the robot's log file. Open it in the SysId tool, which is part of WPILib, to get the gains.
